# P25 — Cost and fundraising/sales request experiences

Status: **blocked_external**. Independent finance UI/read seams and local P25_A1–A3 delivered. Actual provider/authority/privacy/human gates remain; no P26 implementation.

## Delivered behavior

Migration033;67tables/759columns/93public functions. Added narrow `read_finance_intake`, `list_finance_cases`, `read_finance_gate`; the existing read_request signature/scope is retained with a server-derived governedKind. P24 monetary, immutable request/evidence binding and atomic submission remain authoritative. Interface details: docs/finance.md.

FinanceRequestForm captures typed cost/budget/expense/reimbursement/fundraising/sales plans, itemized PHP/quantities, exact requested total, price/forecast/revenue/negative margin, fund/purpose/beneficiary, independent optional deliverable/date, and terms/risks/school requirements. Invalid partial lines show field errors and no invented total. Current configured envelope requirements, final-file choices and process note stay separate; the protected currency adapter derives from P24's total. No field authorizes approval. Zero cost or zero forecast still uses FIN submission. Generic save is hidden; typed edits are explicitly memory-only until confirmed submission.

FinanceCasePage provides authorized private current/history views, exact selected evidence downloads, separate submitted request/forecast/authorized/actual labels, explicit revision/cancel actions and no financial authority. Historical mutations require returning to current view. FinanceDesk lists the current requester's cases with scoped rows/counts; missing independent FIN reviewer authority is explicit. P24 currently permits only admitted requesters, so no reviewer entitlement is invented to fill the desk. P26 owns those grants and approval execution. FIN/MCD hooks remain fail-closed; no authorization/ledger/actuals/payment.

Catalog/my-request links reach typed finance routes; request reads route FIN by server kind. Sign-in returns preserve exact finance paths while stripping queries. Identity-bound FinanceMemory and existing FormDrafts preserve typed/configured values through conflicts and scope remounts; sign-out/identity change clears them. Uncertain replies lock inputs/actions and recover only the identical command/key. No optimistic success, automatic retry or raw private browser storage. Current reads replace private contents after refresh/focus/revocation.

Task and deliverable panels consume a separate neutral gate RPC. It returns exactly one state, no case ID/count/title/amount/receipt/link. Source detail access is required; task-to-parent access is never inferred. A permitted linked typed plan can be pending; insufficient parent scope/no evidence never means approved. Reviewer/file authority is unchanged.

Files: migration033; finance intake/api/Memory/form/page/desk/CSS and unit tests; router/auth gateway/provider/return paths; generic FIN request routing; catalog links; FormRenderer hideSave option; safe task/deliverable gate consumers; generated types; synthetic fixture/preview/test/browser scripts; docs/contracts/STATE/plan/evidence. Existing equivalent P21/P24/P12 modules reused, no dependency or visual redesign.
